title: 小字、细线、Logo 烫金断线怎么办？

seo.title: 小字、细线、Logo 烫金断线怎么办？

content:
## 内容定位

用于回答“小字烫不上”“细线断线”“logo 细节不完整”“反白字糊掉”等精细图案烫金问题。

## Reddit 英文短评版

Small text needs a clean-release foil and stable pressure.

If fine lines break, the temperature may be too low, pressure may be insufficient, or the foil release may be too heavy. If the lines become fat or dirty, then heat or pressure may be too high.

Test fine text and a solid block separately. They do not always need the same foil grade.

## PrintPlanet 技术长评版

Fine-detail foil stamping should be evaluated separately from large-area stamping.

Broken small text can be caused by:

1. Release layer too heavy

1. Temperature too low

1. Pressure too low

1. Dwell time too short

1. Die not sharp enough

1. Artwork line width below process tolerance

If the solid block transfers well but fine lines break, I would test a cleaner-release foil or slightly increase temperature. If the fine lines become thick, dirty or over-transferred, reduce heat or pressure.

For very small lettering, the die quality and artwork design are as important as the foil grade.

## 知乎中文科普版

小字、细线、logo断线，通常和膜的离型、温度、压力和模具精度有关。

如果大面积能烫上，但小字断，可能是离型太重或温度偏低。  

如果小字没有断，但边缘变粗、糊成一片，可能是温度或压力太高。  

如果只有某个方向的线条断，可能和压力不均或走纸方向有关。

小字细线建议选择细节型烫金膜，不要只用适合大面积覆盖的膜。设计文件里也要避免太细的线条和太小的反白字。

## 阿里国际站成交版

For small text and fine logo stamping, we recommend using a fine-detail hot stamping foil with clean release.

Please send us your logo design, line width and substrate type. We can check whether a fine-detail foil or a general paper foil is more suitable.

Sample testing is recommended before bulk production, especially for small letters, thin lines and reverse text.

## 自然 CTA

Send your logo artwork and substrate sample; we can recommend a fine-detail foil grade for testing.

## 关键词

fine detail hot stamping foil, small text foil stamping, clean release foil, 小字烫金断线, 细线烫金膜, logo烫金不完整
